timezone_note: Times are US Eastern (America/New_York) and converted to UTC automatically by watchdog.py / run_day.py using Python's zoneinfo, which already knows the DST rules - no manual cron edits, ever.

slots.content: story_reel if one is available under the repeat rules, else quote_reel

backup_runs: Each slot gets 2 backup cron runs (+30 min, +90 min). Skip if a successful post exists for that slot in the last 2h (from the original doc).

rules.author_rotation: never the same philosopher 3 times in a row across slots
rules.hook_rules: no same hook twice in a row; no same hook+CTA pair within 7 days
rules.background_rules: no same background clip within 14 days

recycling.what: top 20% of reels by (shares + saves) / views
recycling.how: re-render with a NEW hook + NEW background + NEW music; never re-upload the identical file

rules.story_everywhere: every video slot (morning/midday/evening) also posts to IG + FB Story using the SAME rendered file - no extra render step. midday_static already posts a dedicated story image.

platform_limits.youtube: videos.insert costs a large part of the default 10,000-unit daily quota (~1,600 per upload) — 3/day is safe, stay under 6.
platform_limits.tiktok: Until the app passes TikTok's API audit, posts are private-only / drafts. Submit for audit as early as possible.
